nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.batch_stage3_aggregate¶

Batch stage-3 Excel aggregation (invoked inside Singularity on the cluster).

Concatenates per-subject per_subject/<subj>.xlsx files into <batch>_SummaryCodebook.xlsx for each requested pipeline, mirroring local nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.stage3_batch_summary.aggregate_stage3_summary().
